meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 是否健康,与最新源码对比,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论附命令输出或文件证据。只诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库;需你要求才应用修复。
howto.when: 当你要求做健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常,怀疑安装过期、漂移或损坏,或想对照最新代码审计本地安装时触发。

say.text: 检查我的 LazyCodex 安装是否健康
say.note: 运行诊断并输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 刚更新了 Codex,行为有点怪,帮我看看
say.note: 对比最新源码,查找漂移或配置问题

say.text: 审计本机 Codex 配置和插件是否最新
say.note: 检查 config.toml、插件清单和版本

howto.what_en: Inspects local LazyCodex/Codex installs against latest sources; outputs PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence. Diagnosis only—no changes to your install or config.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a doctor/health check, mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after install/update/config change, or suspects a stale/drifted/broken setup.

say_en.text: Check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: Runs diagnosis and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report.

say_en.text: I just updated Codex and it's acting weird—can you look?
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources for drift or config issues.

say_en.text: Audit my local Codex config and plugins for freshness.
say_en.note: Checks config.toml, plugin manifest, and versions.
